description: Start signing the user in to a restaurant so they can place orders. Browsing the menu never needs this — only ordering and saving an address do. Returns a URL the user must open in a browser to sign in with Google or Apple; afterwards they copy the 'code' value from the address bar and you call submit_login_code. Each restaurant has its own login, so this must be done per restaurant.

clientId.description: clientId of the restaurant to sign in to, from a list_vendors result. Omit only when the server is configured for a single restaurant.

name: login
title: Start signing in
